t: Pre-flight declaration before any destructive data mutation
gb: PathFinder Historian first pass (2026-03-25) via incoming signal
challenge: Agents execute write/delete/restructure operations on production data files without pausing to state intent. Users discover the change after it happens. PathFinder session 16 had 3 jobs.json wipes from agents executing destructive ops without pre-stating intent.
hypothesis: Add pre-flight declaration to stewardship guard (wai-stewardship-guard.md): before any shell command or API call that writes/deletes/mutates a data file, agent states exactly what it will change and the effect, then waits for user acknowledgment. One sentence, not a ceremony. Applies to any file outside WAI-Spoke/ that contains user data.
next_step: add pre-flight rule to wai-stewardship-guard.md; trigger: any write/delete on non-WAI-Spoke files

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Improvement idea: mandatory pre-flight before destructive data operations.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: An instruction to implement immediately without user direction.

resolution_note: Captured in pre-tool-guard hook. Destructive ops already blocked.
